info.title: PlayerHaat API
info.description:
Bangladesh-wide player discovery for local sports.

Success: `{ data, meta }`. Error: `{ error: { code, message, details } }` — the app translates `code`.
Money is whole BDT. Times are ISO-8601 UTC.
